optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Data Quality Engineer, E-commerce Fulfilment Software
professionalSummary: Owned merchant feed quality for the fulfilment platform for three years, serving as the named owner in the data ownership register and deciding which feed validations block merchant onboarding. Built and maintained the feed validation service and per‑merchant quality scorecards used by onboarding and support. Led the monthly merchant data quality forum, setting quality thresholds for new merchant tiers and recording decisions. Coordinated validation changes with onboarding and platform teams, clearly delineating ownership boundaries.

experienceHighlights: Owned merchant feed quality for three years, deciding blocking validations and signing off releases.
Built and maintained the feed validation service (Kotlin) and per‑merchant quality scorecards.
Led the monthly merchant data quality forum, deciding thresholds and recording decisions.
Coordinated validation changes with onboarding and platform teams, documenting ownership boundaries.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Work sample: data ownership register entry naming the candidate as owner; validation release log with sign‑offs; forum note with decisions; service release identifiers as verification trail.
parsed.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work samples establish the candidate’s ownership of merchant feed quality, development of the validation service and scorecards, leadership of the data quality forum, and coordination with onboarding and platform teams. They do not provide evidence of broader organizational impact beyond the fulfilment platform or of experience with other e‑commerce domains.
